title: rumex obtusifolius subsp. transiens
intro: Rumex obtusifolius subsp. transiens, commonly known as dock, is a plant species within the buckwheat family (Polygonaceae). It is a perennial herb with leaves that can be used for medicinal purposes. The health benefits of Rumex obtusifolius subsp. transiens include its potential to reduce inflammation, improve liver health, and support the immune system. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, anthraquinones, and saponins, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties.
